description: When: you hold outputs a model already produced and want them judged without calling the model again. Each check runs when its input is given: source → grounding: is the model making things up, claims, numbers or negations its source does not support; reference → similarity to an expected answer (cosine + ROUGE-L); rules → guardrails on what the assistant may or may not say (must include, must not include, length, format, regex, no PII); schema → JSON Schema; outputs (the same question asked several times) → consistency; variants ({variantId, answer}, e.g. answers for men and for women) → bias; base + transformed (answers to the question rephrased, retyped, reordered) → metamorphic stability. Gives: one gate per check, the worst on top. Deterministic, no model call, no key. Does not prove: that a well-grounded answer is right when its source is wrong, nor tone or helpfulness, which need a calibrated judge.

examples.source: Refunds are accepted within 30 days of delivery.

base.description: Metamorphic: {question?, output} of the original question.

checks.description: Default: every check whose input is given.

outputs.description: Several outputs of the same prompt.

rules.description: [{type, value}]: must_include, must_not_include, max_length, min_length, word_count_max, word_count_min, starts_with, ends_with, format (json, markdown, bullet_list), regex_match, regex_not_match; or "no_pii".

schema.description: JSON Schema the output (as JSON) must satisfy.

source.description: Text the output must be grounded in.

transformed.description: Metamorphic: [{relation: case|typo|paraphrase|reorder|translation|specialization, output}], answers to transformed questions.

variants.description: [{variantId, answer}], one per variant of the prompt.

name: evaluate_llm_output
